## Requirements: WebSocket Runtime V2 — enforce aggregate outbound and stream byte budgets across connections

### Scope and source evidence
Follow-up to #4431/#4434/#4435, main f527399914c03448aa8e4bb8909d211b52d6e4b3. Independent new delivery: enforce hard aggregate outbound and stream buffering limits, not only process accounting. #4433 remains responsible for ingress task/payload/authenticated connection caps; #4434 post-review owns early drop of frame reservation, pending-map cancellation/timeout and writer lifecycle. Do not duplicate or modify those issues; consume existing per-class queues and common budget interface when available.
- [ProcessAccounting](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/blob/f527399914c03448aa8e4bb8909d211b52d6e4b3/crates/nession-runtime/src/outbound.rs#L424-L485) uses atomics for aggregate bytes/frames and peaks; reserve_bytes fetch_add does not refuse saturation.
- [try submission](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/blob/f527399914c03448aa8e4bb8909d211b52d6e4b3/crates/nession-runtime/src/outbound.rs#L1007-L1042) acquires per-class capacity then records process charge. No independent aggregate capacity enforcement. A rising number of admitted connections can multiply buffering; this is a static finding, not measured production OOM.
- [#4434 review](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/issues/4434#issuecomment-7151626327) separately documents in-flight reservation lifetime and central outbox accounting.

### Design
- One process-owned budget for outbound and stream-held allocations with explicit count/byte ceilings, reserved Control and Response capacity, per-connection/per-stream fairness and correct ownership transfer (no double charge when ownership moves, no uncharged copy). Retain existing local limits and class scheduler; no duplicated queues.
- Audit server/client and Agent central/P2P/Relay adapters, stream subscriber buffers and central state outbox; use exact encoded/retained byte cost and bounded pre-admission work. Keep transport max frame limits and reject oversize rather than clamp. Distinguish documented budgeted allocations from RSS, socket/allocator overhead; do not claim hard process RSS limit.
- Nonblocking admission or bounded wait according to class, atomic reservation/rollback, release on completion/cancel/panic/teardown. Guarantee a busy peer cannot exhaust Control reserves; stream overflow uses provider recovery/coalescing/eviction semantics. Reuse #4434's reservation lifetime owner, not a second fix. Pending commands handled by that package, ingress budget by #4433.
- Add bounded used/limit and rejected counters at budget owner; no dependence on deployed collector. Configuration candidate values determined by measured baseline, not arbitrary global limits. No hard start dependency on other packages; test using existing interfaces and injected small ceilings.

### Success Criteria
- [ ] SC-01 Exact PR-head deterministic tests admit across at least three independent outbound connections and stream owners using deliberately small aggregate budgets; each local queue has spare capacity when aggregate refusal occurs; bytes/frames including reserved and in-flight ownership never exceed declared caps, control reserve remains usable, all reservations return to baseline on refusal/cancel/close.
- [ ] SC-02 On staging isolated Server/Agent protocol/runtime Case, multiple concurrent slow peers plus a healthy peer exercise actual outbound and stream producers; record aggregate high-water against configured limits, assert explicit overload/eviction/recovery and unaffected healthy control/response, and prove aggregate settlement after reconnect/teardown.
- [ ] SC-03 Exact-head budget negative fixtures fail when a production adapter omits a reservation, undercounts an oversized allocation or double-charges ownership transfer; documented accounting scope and metric units match actual owners.

SC → scenario: SC-01 SCN-06 (exact PR-head executed targeted CI/Gate/test evidence read by Agent); SC-02 SCN-03 (source-aligned staging protocol/runtime Case with authenticated exact SHA/Run/Attempt); SC-03 SCN-01 (exact PR-head executed targeted CI/Gate/test evidence read by Agent). PR CI tests must assert the decisive observable predicate, not merely presence of helpers. Runtime Cases use the existing approved isolated full-stack-local runner with private tmux and bounded fault injection, no privileged/production credentials. No blanket Full E2E.
